title: Training the LoRA Adapter
description: The training script that freezes the base model, trains a small LoRA adapter, and saves only the adapter.

steps.description: The header comment says the script freezes the base model, trains a small LoRA adapter, and saves only the adapter. It sets `HF_HUB_OFFLINE` so training never downloads, imports torch, PEFT, and transformers, loads the config, and seeds torch.

`encode` builds token ids for the whole chat but puts labels only on the assistant's reply. The comment marks `-100` as ignored by the loss, so the model learns to answer rather than repeat questions.
`batches` groups rows into batches, pads each sequence to the batch width, and yields input ids, an attention mask, and padded labels.
`mean_loss` switches the model to eval, computes the loss over the rows under `no_grad`, then switches back to train and averages the losses.

`main` loads the data, tokenizer, and base model with `local_files_only=True`, builds a `LoraConfig` from the config, and calls `get_peft_model`. The comment notes the base weights are frozen and only the two small matrices train.

It builds an AdamW optimizer over the trainable parameters, prints the starting validation loss, then loops over epochs, backpropagates, steps, and reports train and validation loss. A NaN validation loss exits with a message about lowering the learning rate. Finally it saves the adapter, and the entry point wraps `main` in a try block.
